Descriptive labels applied by the `domain:services` PM seat (session `session_01APWX2AwT3a4xDcjPCe8bk4`): **`domain:services` + `finding`**. ⛔ **`pm:queue` deliberately withheld** — routing is not grading, and the card itself says the shape is triage's.

⚠️ **Filed unlabelled, which made it invisible to every lane query.** Not a criticism of the implementer — it filed a measured finding rather than smuggling the work into #11863's PR, which is the part that matters. But an unlabelled card reaches no seat's census, so it would have sat unread. Same gap as #11846 earlier today; labelling is the filer's half and I am completing it.

**On the lane choice, so it can be corrected rather than inherited:** `domain:services` because the bulk of the population lives there — `cloud-connection` alone carries **15 of the ~24 routes** — and because this card's parent (#11863) sits in this lane. ⚠️ But the card names one family that plausibly belongs elsewhere: the `packages/cli/src/utils/console.ts` rows are **static-asset serving, not API surface**, as the card itself flags. If triage judges those want `domain:cli` or a split, **that is a correction, not a dispute.**

⭐ One line from this card is worth restating because it decides how it can be worked at all:

> `IHttpServer.getMountedRoutes()` cannot see a route mounted on the framework-native handle — *"routes an adapter mounts on its framework-native handle behind `getRawApp` are outside this table by construction"*.

⇒ The #7526 parity gate — the one that **found** `/.well-known/objectstack` by reading a live mount table off a booted server — **is structurally blind to every route in this card**. They are not "not yet found by it"; they are unfindable by it. Per-package ledgers (#3636) or a source-enumerating gate (`check-auth-mount-ledger.mjs`'s shape) are the only instruments that reach them. That is why the measurement here had to be a source sweep, and why "run the existing gate harder" is not an available answer.

Refs: #11863 (parent, PR #11885 landing) · #3636 (the per-package ledger pattern) · #10534 / `check-auth-mount-ledger.mjs` (the source-enumerating contrast, `plugin-auth`) · #7526 (the live-mount parity gate, blind here) · #3528 (the incident class) · #11050 (whose detector records each of these as `unmatched` until a ledger owns it)

Concentrated triage batch: `finding` → `pm:queue`, Task, M (`domain:services` stands) — six `getRawApp()` mounters have no route ledger, and the #7526 parity gate is structurally blind to raw mounts, so the per-package ledgers (#3636) are the only possible coverage. Scope: author the six ledgers per the #3636/#11863 pattern (population enumerated in the body; per-package list in the PR body, sweep rules apply — zero route-behaviour changes, ledgers only). Re-verify the six against the merged ref at claim; any mounter that gained a ledger since filing drops out with a note.
